title: Find Stationary Points
text:
Set $\frac{dV}{dx} = 0$:

$x^2 - 14x + 36 = 0$

Using the quadratic formula:
$x = \frac{14 \pm \sqrt{196 - 144}}{2} = \frac{14 \pm \sqrt{52}}{2} = \frac{14 \pm 7.21}{2}$

$x = 10.61$ or $x = 3.39$

Since $0 < x < 9$, only $x = 3.39$ is valid.

title: Verify Maximum and Calculate Volume
text:
To verify it is a maximum, use the second derivative:
$\frac{d^2V}{dx^2} = 24x - 168$

At $x = 3.39$: $\frac{d^2V}{dx^2} = 24(3.39) - 168 = -86.64 < 0$

Since the second derivative is negative, this is a maximum.

Maximum volume:
$V = 4(3.39)^3 - 84(3.39)^2 + 432(3.39)$
$V = 155.72 - 965.30 + 1464.48$
$V \approx 655.47$ cm^3
